lines: Be it remembered that on the twenty seventh day of July Anno Domini Seventeen hundred and Ninety seven,
Letters of Administration on the Estate of William Durham were in due form of Law granted unto Mary Durham
who being sworn gave bond with Joseph (unclear) surity in the sum of Five hundred pounds lawful money of
the State of Delaware as by the Bond filed may at large appear.
Administration Account- William Durham- dec'd- April 8th,
To the Register for the Probate of Wills and granting Letters of Admin. in and for the County of Kent
in the State of Delaware, Mary Derham Admnt. of all and Singular the Goods and Chattels  Rights & Credits
which will of William Derham Dec'd wishes to render and pass the following accounts of her Amin. of said
To Cash paid for Ketters of Adm.............................0..16..3
Examined, Adjusted, Proved & Settled the 8th April,
Inventory of William Durham, dec. - April 8th
the above amt. for in the first acct.
To Isaac Davis Reg. Mary Durham Administratrix of William Durham dec'd Presents the following account
distributive of said dec'd and prays its Adjustment.
By the balance of personal estate as account passed this day..12..8..4
Benjamin Durham.......By your Share of Bal.................3..19..9 1/4
Ibba Durham...........By your Share of Bal.................3..19..9 1/4
Add'l Admin. Acct. William Derram, the 6 May,

Additional Account of her Administration on the Estate of said Deceased and prays it may be allowed
Balance in the Hands of the Administratrix.................39..7..10 3/4
By a Bal. in the hands of the Admin. as per
By Interest on this sum from the 20th July
